title: Can Domain Generalization be Guaranteed in Small-Sample Learning?
abstract: arXiv:2609.39512v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The small-sample learning problem remains a fundamental challenge in machine learning because limited training data lead to unstable model estimation and generalization. Structural Risk Minimization (SRM) has long been regarded as a principled solution under the classical i.i.d. assumption. However, domain generalization (DG) violates this assumption, leaving the theoretical role of SRM in DG largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we establish the first theoretical guarantees for SRM in DG under mild assumptions. Specifically, based on the concept of stability, we derive learning consistency and generalization error bounds and prove that these bounds become tight when the hypotheses satisfy the stability condition. Building upon this, under a specific hypothesis space assumption, we establish stability, learning, and generalization bounds for SRM. We further discuss the applicability of these bounds to deep learning. This work establish

translated_title: 小样本学习中的领域泛化能否得到保证？
translated_abstract: 小样本学习问题仍然是机器学习中的一个根本性挑战，因为有限的训练数据会导致模型估计和泛化的不稳定性。结构风险最小化长期以来被视为经典独立同分布（i.i.d.）假设下一个有原则的解决方案。然而，领域泛化（DG）违反了这一假设，使得SRM在DG中的理论作用在很大程度上尚未被探索。为了弥合这一差距，我们在温和的假设下首次为SRM在DG中建立了理论保证。具体而言，基于稳定性的概念，我们推导了学习一致性和泛化误差界，并证明当假设满足稳定性条件时，这些界会变得紧致。在此基础上，在特定的假设空间假设下，我们为SRM建立了稳定性、学习和泛化界。我们进一步讨论了这些界在深度学习中的适用性。这项工作建立了……
tldr: 本文首次在温和假设下为结构风险最小化（SRM）在领域泛化中建立了理论保证，基于稳定性概念推导了学习一致性和泛化误差界，并证明当假设满足稳定性条件时这些界是紧致的。
en_tdlr: This work establishes the first theoretical guarantees for Structural Risk Minimization (SRM) in domain generalization under mild assumptions, deriving learning consistency and generalization error bounds based on stability that become tight when hypotheses satisfy the stability condition.
